name: lv_obj_set_text_font

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-10-3.1.28 image: three instructions that forward (obj, value, selector) to the local-style setter with property 90.

notes: LVGL v8 text-font property setter: lv_obj_set_local_style_prop(obj, 90, font, selector). The alarm prompt (0xc235580) does lv_label_create, reads property 90 off the global font-holder 0x200a25fc, applies it with this entry, then sets the label text, which is the stock body-text font path. Used by lvx_page_title_create too. Not device probed.
